get_trainer_params: get trainer parameters from a TrainerConf by converting plugin short names to PyTorch Lightning plugin instances
convert_trainer_plugins: convert a list of plugin short names like ddp_fully_sharded into corresponding PyTorch Lightning plugin instances
get_fully_sharded_plugins: get fully sharded training plugins including DDPFullyShardedStrategy and optional mixed precision plugin for 16-bit training
merge_ddp_plugin_conf: merge multiple DDPStrategyConf configurations into one by combining non-None attributes across all provided configs
DDPStrategyConf: create a DDPStrategyConf dataclass to configure DDP communication hooks, wrappers, and find_unused_parameters settings
